8282.title: ACP child-session negotiation and routing gaps
8282.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge omits child-session negotiation, drops non-parent session updates, and has no lifecycle-to-delegation translation; prompt deadlines are explicitly disabled.
8282.proposedFix: Validate the provider extension contract, add typed child-session routing and lifecycle translation before capability opt-in, and define bounded progress-aware cancellation.
8282.caveats: Both same-agent clean runs confirm bridge gaps using a synthetic peer. Real Cursor early termination and hung drain were not reproduced. Repro code and output are inline because this reports repository forbids artifact files. No fix PR: protocol/schema changes and timeout-policy decisions exceed the simple-fix gate.
